authorized_by: Root coordinator before unstarted B wave4 and future A games
scope: Future games only; prior completed controls remain unchanged.
selection: Prefer up to four unannotated raw legal-offer positions, nearest historical nomination then captures. If fewer offers exist, fill up to two controls using the previous deterministic control rule.
labels: Every selected control requires an explicit visible UI label. Retain any Brilliant response, disagreement or shortfall; never force a negative class.
limits: Static unchanged isMuteSacrifice only; no engine, model scores, current labels or threshold tuning in selection. Unscanned predicates remain unknown.
evaluation: Training and assessment candidates/baseline use the same selected cases; reserved challenge sampling must be reported.
